designationHistory.indexText: Established on February 11, 1980, by Public Land Order 5703 issued by the Secretary of the Interior; it absorbed the Cape Newenham National Wildlife Refuge (1969) and was confirmed by the Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act in December 1980.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page does not say how it was established.

review.note: Date confirmed. Established by Interior Secretary Andrus's public land order, not by a presidential signature (Carter was President). Older predecessor: Cape Newenham NWR, PLO 4583, Jan. 20, 1969.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Togiak National Wildlife Refuge was established on February 11, 1980, but is part of a much larger region that has its own special history.
